task: Generate and evaluate one identity-preserving Lyra V1.5 functional character master.
surface: Internal Starlight character and workflow atlas; prospective .ai and .org profile surfaces after approval.
audience: Creators, developers, founders, researchers, and operators evaluating understandable governed agent systems.
first_read: Lyra is a calm synthetic research conductor whose body turns bounded evidence inputs into one reviewable packet.

references.label: Owned Lyra v1 identity anchor
references.reason: Preserve the recognized cranium, compact optics, adult proportions, material family, and calm identity.

references.label: Character art bible
references.reason: Apply the V1.5 identity lane, role-shaped morphology, surface policy, and one-call approval gate.

references.label: First Lyra pilot review
references.reason: Preserve negative evidence and explicitly correct identity drift, costume, fake-interface, crop, and role-legibility failures.

keep: owned Lyra v1 cranium, faceplate, compact optics, adult scale, and calm precision
porcelain, obsidian, deep ink blue, restrained warm metal, and sparse cyan activity
neutral full-body studio composition with generous crop safety
avoid: long coat, high collar, glowing chest core, floating cards, portal, pedestal, and fake interface
oversized eyes, human facial mimicry, chibi authority, and sexualized anatomy
generic premium humanoid styling without role-shaped function
direction.signature: Three mechanically bounded evidence inputs converge into one sealed human-review packet within Lyra's serviceable research-conductor body.
system: V1.5 cinematic functional identity is the primary character lane
V3 morphology makes specialty legible before supporting copy
generated character art remains separate from exact code-rendered workflows, labels, permissions, and state
one generated master per call with prompt, receipt, repo copy, export inspection, and 30-point score

asset_quality.why_premium: The candidate uses an owned identity reference, a single controlled functional hypothesis, an exact persisted prompt, one generated master, a repo-preserved source copy, full-export inspection, and a governed stop decision.

artifacts.notes: 1122 × 1402 PNG inspected at high detail after repo copy.
Exact prompt, reference role, generated-image receipt, repo path, hash, dimensions, and self-review are recorded.
Maker review scores the candidate 25 of 30 and routes it to one targeted iteration.

checks.name: machine-admission
checks.evidence: Peak Performance interactive preflight returned ALLOW with a one-parallel-job bound.

checks.name: one-call-policy
checks.evidence: One built-in image generation call produced one character master.

checks.name: prompt-and-provenance
checks.evidence: The owned reference, exact prompt, original generated path, repo copy, SHA-256, and pixel dimensions are preserved.

checks.name: full-export-inspection
checks.evidence: The repo PNG was inspected at high detail after copying.

checks.name: identity-preservation
checks.evidence: The faceplate, compact optics, cranium, adult scale, and material lineage remain recognizably Lyra.

checks.name: role-transformation
checks.evidence: The routing channels exist but do not yet explain the research-conductor specialty without copy.

checks.name: independent-human-review
checks.evidence: Frank has not yet selected this candidate and maker self-review cannot approve it.

score.notes: Keep the identity and visual craft; iterate only the visible three-input-to-one-review-packet function.

known_risks: The clean premium humanoid body can still read as generic without an unmistakable role-shaped mechanism.
Fanout before identity approval would multiply correction cost across the full cast.
A generated portrait cannot communicate workflow topology, authority, version, permissions, or installation truth; those remain deterministic UI layers.
